About

We built OwnerOS AI because we kept seeing the same problem.

Owner-led businesses are run by incredibly capable people who built something real — but are stuck operating it the same way they did when they had 3 employees, even when they now have 30.

The business has outgrown the system. But the system is still: the owner's memory, a shared inbox, a few spreadsheets, and whoever picks up the phone first.

The founding team

F1

Marketing & AI Operations

Background in marketing strategy, lead generation, CRM design, content systems, landing pages, reporting, higher education marketing, local business marketing, and AI-assisted business operations.

PM · Workflow mapping · Implementation · Documentation · Rollout planning · QA · Delivery

How we work

We build things that get used.

Every engagement produces working systems — SOPs, automations, dashboards, trained staff. Not reports about what you should do someday.

We work with what you have.

We don't recommend tools to add complexity. We start with your existing stack and only introduce new tools when they solve a specific problem simply.

We document everything.

Your operating system lives in your tools, not our heads. When we're done, you own every piece — SOPs, templates, automations, dashboards.

AI supports humans. Always.

We never deploy AI outputs without human review. AI drafts, suggests, and summarizes — humans approve, edit, and decide.

We're honest about what's possible.

No guaranteed revenue projections. No 'fully automated business' promises. We tell you what we can build, what it will take, and what you can realistically expect.

We stay until it works.

We don't hand off and disappear. We train the team, support the first 30 days, and offer ongoing partnership for businesses that want to keep improving.

Want to work with us?
